breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The ground truth prompt corrected the error by removing the instruction to treat the distributed self-weight as a single concentrated load. The agent's generated text, however, repeated the incorrect instruction verbatim: 'For the elongation calculation, replace the distributed self-weight by a single concentrated load equal to the total weight acting at the free end.' It then proceeded to perform the calculation based on this flawed method instead of the correct integration method.
